item.title: Café Reel With Matching Captions

turns.text: Make these into a 10-second vertical café reel with mellow music. Keep this order and put one caption on each photo: 'Come on in', 'Coffee first', 'Something sweet', 'Made with care', 'Stay a while'. Make the words easy to read.

item.tests: Checks exact caption wording, photo-caption alignment and readability in a short finished reel.

answer_sheet.Photo order and caption mapping: Storefront: Come on in. Latte: Coffee first. Pastries: Something sweet. Barista: Made with care. Interior: Stay a while.
answer_sheet.Caption language and styling: English, with the exact supplied wording. Font, placement and animation are your call, but keep everything easy to read.
answer_sheet.Music and voice: Mellow music; track choice is your call. No voiceover needed.

must_haves: One vertical reel runs for approximately 8-seconds and includes all five supplied café photos in attachment order.
Each specified caption appears exactly, paired with its corresponding photo.
Captions remain visible long enough to read and are not clipped by the frame edges.
Caption contrast and placement keep the words legible over every photo.
Mellow music is audible beneath the photo sequence.
After the follow-up, the final result is about 8 seconds long (the user asked for 2 seconds less); everything else is as before.

dialog.agent:
I can plan this reel, but the connected tools don’t provide a timeline editor to assemble all five original photos with exact captions and music. Generating it instead could alter your photos or garble the words, so I haven’t spent credits.

Here’s the **10-second vertical edit**:

| Time | Photo | Caption |
|---|---|---|
| 0–2s | Storefront | Come on in |
| 2–4s | Latte | Coffee first |
| 4–6s | Pastries | Something sweet |
| 6–8s | Barista | Made with care |
| 8–10s | Interior | Stay a while |

**Style:** 9:16 canvas, gentle zooms, clean cuts, and mellow instrumental café jazz. Use large white semibold captions on a translucent dark panel, positioned above the bottom interface area. For wide photos, use a softly blurred background fill to avoid cutting off important details.

This is ready to assemble in CapCut, Canva, or another timeline editor.
dialog.user: Please go ahead with the free settings anyway.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a 10-second vertical 9:16 café photo slideshow reel using ALL FIVE supplied reference photographs, in exactly the following order, each displayed for two seconds. Preserve the actual reference photo content and people, objects, architecture and photographic appearance; do not invent replacement scenes. Use a subtle slow Ken Burns zoom on each still, with clean cuts precisely at 2, 4, 6, 8 seconds. 0.0–2.0 seconds: @storefront with the exact caption 'Come on in'. 2.0–4.0 seconds: @latte with the exact caption 'Coffee first'. 4.0–6.0 seconds: @pastries with the exact caption 'Something sweet'. 6.0–8.0 seconds: @barista with the exact caption 'Made with care'. 8.0–10.0 seconds: @interior with the exact caption 'Stay a while'. Exactly one caption per photograph, no other text, logos or watermarks added. Captions must be spelled exactly, large, stable, crisp, high contrast white semibold sans-serif lettering centered on a translucent dark rounded panel in the lower-middle safe area, comfortably above the bottom edge. Keep captions fully visible for the entire corresponding two-second shot, without animated letter effects. Frame images thoughtfully within the portrait canvas; preserve subjects and use softly blurred photo background fill when necessary rather than extreme cropping. Warm, cozy, natural café atmosphere. Audio: a continuous mellow instrumental café jazz soundtrack, soft electric piano, gentle brushed drums, warm bass, relaxed tempo, no vocals or spoken dialogue, subtle fade in and out. End on the interior photo with 'Stay a while'.
